findings.summary: T3 defines S, T, G, E, D, SI, ZW, AP and a state-dependence witness, but the available-branch scheduler class and witness quantifiers remain a textual meta-theorem
the atomic-window unit inequality is aligned and fail-closed on controlled abort paths, but general RuntimeContractError paths do not uniformly produce a waste audit
the model and runtime share aggregate phase and whole-batch publication granularity, but no simulation property or independent refinement replay proves the relation
finite measured Cmax is absent; this does not refute the normalized unit inequality but blocks a non-vacuous physical-cost and Level 2 positive claim

remaining_actions: state the T3 scheduler class and quantifier order as a reviewable theorem or mechanize the meta-theorem
emit a unit-level waste audit for every failure path that can discard an uncommitted transaction
add a mechanically checked or independently replayed aggregate refinement relation
measure and bind finite Cmax before any physical-cost or Level 2 positive claim
